expectedTruths: Population latent correlation corr(A,B) = 0.95; with equal loadings (.80) the population HTMT(A,B) on the continuous responses is exactly 0.95.

HTMT(A,B) computed from data.csv (Pearson correlations, arithmetic means of hetero-trait and mono-trait correlations, Henseler et al. 2015) = 0.9731522140079828; any correct HTMT implementation reproduces it to ~1e-10. It is above 0.90, so discriminant validity of A and B must be flagged under both the 0.85 and the 0.90 thresholds.
HTMT involving C is not expected to be flagged at the population level (population HTMT(A,C) = HTMT(B,C) = corr = 0.585000).
